title: States & Accessibility
description: Interactive states, error states, loading states, and accessibility requirements

focus.notes: Focus ring using brand teal color

error.notes: Not visible in screenshot but should be implemented

active-toggled.notes: When password is visible, icon changes to EyeOff and may use brand color

loading.content: Spinner icon + 'ログイン中...' or disabled with spinner
loading.notes: Should show loading state during API call

hover.notes: Subtle white wash on hover to indicate clickability

demo-account-row.click-behavior: Auto-fills email input with selected account's email address

empty-email.display: Red border on input + error message below
empty-email.message: メールアドレスを入力してください

invalid-email-format.message: 有効なメールアドレスを入力してください

empty-password.display: Red border on password input + error message
empty-password.message: パスワードを入力してください

auth-failure.display: Toast notification or form-level error above button
auth-failure.message: メールアドレスまたはパスワードが正しくありません
auth-failure.style: bg-[#FEF2F2] border border-[#FECACA] text-[#DC2626] rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-[13px]

semantic-html.labels: Use <label htmlFor> linked to input id
semantic-html.heading: <h1> for clinic name
semantic-html.list: <ul>/<li> for demo account list or role='list'

aria-attributes.email-input: aria-label='メールアドレス' or linked label
aria-attributes.password-input: aria-label='パスワード', aria-describedby for toggle button
aria-attributes.toggle-button: aria-label='パスワードを表示' / 'パスワードを非表示' (toggles with state)
aria-attributes.demo-rows: role='button' aria-label='田中 太郎 としてログイン' etc.
aria-attributes.form-error: aria-describedby linking input to error message

keyboard-navigation.tab-order: Logo (skip) → Email input → Password input → Toggle button → Login button → Demo rows
keyboard-navigation.enter-key: Submits form when focus is on input or button

color-contrast.subtitle: Passes AA: #6B7280 on #F1F0EE (~4.6:1)
color-contrast.label: Passes AA: #374151 on #FFFFFF (~10:1)
color-contrast.placeholder: May fail AA: #9CA3AF on #FFFFFF (~2.9:1) — consider #6B7280 for better compliance

form-submission.button-state: Show spinner, disable button, text changes to ログイン中...
form-submission.duration: Typical API call <2s, no skeleton needed
